name: Sarsour
description: A man pelted and misdirected by a sandstorm.

description_citations.work: Masters Edition IV: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Masters Edition IV: card flavor text (Masters Edition IV, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A sandstorm rises against Sarsour and rearranges the landscape so he is lost.
timeline.quote: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

citation.text: Sandstorm (Arabian Nights, 1993), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
